description: This file defines a PHP class named 'File' within the namespace 'Opencart\System\Library\Cache'. The class provides cache management functionality, including methods to get, set, delete cache entries, and automatic cleanup in destructor. It implements file-based caching, storing cache data in files with expiration handling.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class implementing file-based cache management with expiration, including methods for retrieving, storing, deleting cache entries, and automatic cache cleanup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a default expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cache data for a given key, returning decoded JSON data or an empty array if not found or expired.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores data in cache under a key with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes cache files associated with a given key.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Performs periodic cleanup of expired cache files when the object is destroyed, with a 1% chance per destruction call.
